title: Which diseases already replaced the response-rate summary, and how

A0_the_necessity_question.asked: has oncology already solved this, making the argument unnecessary?
A0_the_necessity_question.answer: partly, repeatedly, and separately. At least four distinct solution families are in use, several carried by named working groups issuing formal criteria. What has NOT happened is generalisation: each fix was made for one disease or one drug class and stayed there.
A0_the_necessity_question.consequence_for_the_paper: the defensible claim is not that oncology has failed to notice. It is that the problem is a property of a coordinate, that the solutions already exist, and that they have not reached the diseases whose coordinates need them most. That is a narrower and more useful paper than the one that would have been written without asking.
A0_the_necessity_question.what_would_have_falsified_the_paper: finding a general, cross-disease treatment of the low-rate/low-accrual regime with an endorsed remedy. None was retrieved. That is an absence in what these queries returned, not a proof that none exists.

definitions.A_switch_to_time_to_event: replace the response summary with a time-to-event or fixed-timepoint progression-free endpoint
definitions.B_redefine_response: keep a response endpoint but redefine it so it detects the biology the agent actually produces
definitions.C_add_categories: keep the endpoint and add categories between response and progression
definitions.D_patient_as_own_control: remove the historical comparator by making each patient their own control

definitions.consensus_guideline: a named working group issuing response or trial-design criteria
definitions.methodology_paper: a design or statistical method, not disease-specific
definitions.single_trial_precedent: one trial or cohort using the approach

A3_endorsement_grades.reading: the disease-specific fixes are mostly consensus guidelines, and the patient-as-own-control family is mostly methodology and single-trial precedent. The family that best addresses the natural-history confound is the one with the least formal endorsement.

A4_diseases_with_an_endorsed_alternative._scope: covered means a document was retrieved for that domain by these queries. It is not a systematic review of guidelines and cannot show that a disease has NO alternative -- only that none was retrieved here.

⚠_covered_is_not_uniformly_endorsed._what_this_measures: for each disease domain, the STRONGEST grade of document retrieved for it, and how many documents that domain rests on
⚠_covered_is_not_uniformly_endorsed._the_honest_summary: consensus guidelines in some domains and trial precedent in the rest. 'Endorsed across N domains' is true only of the first group, and the count of the second is reported beside it rather than folded into it.

A5_the_gap._definition: conditions placed on the regime map with a median objective response of 15% or less
A5_the_gap._why_this_is_the_paper: the fixes exist and are old -- the earliest retrieved document is from 1998. The gap is not invention, it is diffusion: a remedy endorsed in glioma or GIST or lymphoma does not reach a rare tumour whose coordinate is worse than any of them.

transferability.A_switch_to_time_to_event: transfers immediately and costs no patients, but inherits the natural-history confound whole -- it only moves which number is uncalibrated
transferability.B_redefine_response: transfers only where the agent produces a specific non-shrinkage change that imaging can see
transferability.C_add_categories: transfers cheaply and improves reporting, but does not fix the small-sample problem
transferability.D_patient_as_own_control: the only family that attacks the confound rather than relocating it, and the least formally endorsed

A6_what_this_audit_is_not.not_a_systematic_review: the corpus is what a frozen set of queries returned. A disease absent here may have an endorsed alternative that these queries did not reach.
A6_what_this_audit_is_not.assignments_are_judgements: fix family, domain and endorsement grade are read off retrieved titles, journals and abstracts by the author of this file. The records are retrieved; the classification is an opinion that can be disputed without disturbing a citation.
A6_what_this_audit_is_not.no_efficacy_claim: nothing here says any endpoint produced a better treatment decision, or that any agent works. It records what criteria exist and who issued them.
